authority: Supplemental all-of new-candidate review separate from exact runtime hard_gates. New knit profile has its independently selected opt-in native gate.

rows.success: Both separately bounded garments belong to the same pictured woman.
rows.failure: A garment on another figure, sample or background cannot donate this evidence.

rows.success: Both actual garment surfaces carry closely related muted warm tones within one image.
rows.failure: Global warm cast, saturated opposing colors or one hidden garment fails; partial is fail.

rows.success: Both real cloth boundaries remain distinct and readable in the same region and image.
rows.failure: A flat print, hidden seam or missing edge is UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS.

rows.success: Connected opaque yarn paths physically bound multiple actual holes on the same vest.
rows.failure: Printed diamonds, dark filled areas or unresolved yarn continuity fail.

owners: separate peach blouse visible through holes
rows.success: The lower blouse surface is owned separately and visible through true gaps while yarn remains opaque.
rows.failure: A flat combined print, missing lower owner or obscured cells fails.

all_of_policy: Every row for a selected new meaning must pass in the one returned image; no component averaging across images or labels.
